subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 2: revises o, u and -at words; contrasts b and p sounds (bun, pan, pit)

show.line: b or p? b has a voice. p is just a puff! Bun, pan.

rounds.prompt: Listen. Bun. Is it b or p?
Listen. Pit. Is it b or p?
Does it start with b or p? Sort the pictures.

hints: Hand on your throat. b buzzes. p does not.
Say it slowly. Listen to the first sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It says pin. p at the start.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. p, i, n. Pin!

parent_line: Can hear the difference between b and p in words like bun and pan.
